messages:
tess (product): Quick check — ist1 cutover scheduled for Tue 02:00 UTC. Need clear owners for routing/peering, KMS/residency, NAT/GW, and log shipping. Who can own what? @samir @maya @leo @olga

maya (eng-platform): I can own routing config + k8s cutover steps. Will handle route policies and proxy config. @samir pls confirm peering ownership.

samir (netops): I'll take BGP/peering and peering firewall. Need cloud ticket with provider ASN + IP ranges. Also we should decide on BFD (fast failover) vs plain BGP timers. Provider supports BFD.

leo (infra): Infra PR up: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/terraform/compare/ist1-egress — includes NAT gateway, public/private subnets, route tables. Plan shows small diffs. Need reviews from @maya and @samir.

olga (security): Security checklist: 1) customer-managed KMS in-region or HSM tokenization, 2) audit log forwarding from ist1 to central SIEM (TLS), 3) retention policy note for residency customers. I'll need the KMS key name and the collector IPs.

maya (eng-platform): KMS approach: create CMK per-customer in ist1 via secret-ops. I'll coordinate with @olga on the key policy. For log shipping, plan is local collector -> TLS tunnel -> splunk in eu1. @leo can you add egress route for collector?

leo (infra): Added route snippet in PR description:
```
resource "aws_route" "splunk_egress" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.ist1.id
  cidr_block     = "203.0.113.45/32"  # placeholder
  gateway_id     = aws_nat_gateway.ist1.id
}
```
Need the final CIDR from ops. Also added nat gw HA config.

samir (netops): Opened provider ticket INC-4521 with requested ASN/IPs and BFD toggle. Provider ETA ~48h. Also: firewall rules require inbound only from peering and management CIDRs.

tess (product): Milestones: config freeze Thu EOD, PR approvals Fri, dry-run Sat (canary 10%), cutover Tue 02:00 UTC. Owners: routing -> maya, netops -> samir, infra -> leo, security -> olga. Any blockers?

maya (eng-platform): Blocker: DNS delegation — we need zone transfer permissions for the regional zone. @dns-team can you confirm registrar/registrar-lock status?

dns-team (dns): Registrar has to enable delegation. We need the regional NS list from infra. Will open ticket and update by EOD tomorrow.

samir (netops): One operational ask: add fallback to eu1 for residency if ist1 isn't healthy. Proposed route policy: prefer ist1, failover to eu1 after 2s RTO. Also add canary weight 10% for first 24h. @maya thoughts?

maya (eng-platform): Agree on failover policy. I'll add fallback logic to routing controller and proxy config. Canary weight 10% post-cutover, increase after 6h if no errors.

leo (infra): Quick infra note: terraform plan shows a change to subnet tagging and node-labels. Small snippet for node labels for the k8s autoscaler:
```
metadata:
  labels:
    topology.kubernetes.io/region: "ist1"
    redwood/owner: "infra"
```
I'll include that in the PR.

olga (security): Also require audit log endpoint whitelisting and signed TLS certs with CN matching splunk-ingest.redwood.com. I'll draft the policy and post link.

deploy-bot: CI: ist1-provision-plan — SUCCESS — 4 resources to be created, 1 to change. (link: https://ci.redwood/builds/12578)

tess (product): Great — please post PR links when they're ready and tag ownership in the PR description (routing: @maya, netops: @samir, infra: @leo, security: @olga). If DNS or provider tickets slip, we'll push cutover by 24h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maya (eng-platform): I'll add the route policy PR and a proxy canary config patch. Ping me for reviews.

samir (netops): Will follow up with provider and paste BGP config once ticket returns. Planning a pre-cutover smoke window 6h before the cutover.

leo (infra): Putting final infra PR up in 30m. Will tag owners.

dns-team (dns): Filed ticket DNS-778 for delegation. Assigned to registrar, ETA tomorrow noon.

tess (product): OK closing thread for now — reply here if anything urgent changes before the freeze.
